description.value: Intensify Ambient Glow on command into a real light source covering a wide area — useful as illumination, a distraction, or a signal.

cinderfall.incomplete: A real tool exists for this (TokenLight rule element, confirmed real and player-facing via pf2e-source's Crystal Luminescence feat), but the card states no bright/dim radius to build from -- 'a real light source covering a wide area' isn't a foot value. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
